result.title: Fuzzy selective state model for forecasting the dynamics of consumer preferences
result.summary: We consider forecasting the dynamics of consumer preferences of retail chain customers. A customer's preference is described by a triangular fuzzy number. The evolution of the preference over time is governed by a Mamba-type selective state space model whose hidden state is a triangular number, with computations carried out in M.G.~Matveev's two-component algebra of fuzzy numbers. The recurrence parameters are computed from crisp features, while the fuzzy part of the model remains linear with non-negative coefficients. We show that the state then always remains a proper triangular number and is a convex combination of past observations, so that the fuzziness of the forecast does not accumulate over time and the algebraic computations coincide with Zadeh's extension principle. On a synthetic example with competitor promotions and customer switching, a lightweight 107-parameter model reaches a mean absolute error of the forecast centre of 0.154 versus 0.163 for the constant-inertia evolution operator and 0.179 for the naive forecast, matches a crisp model of the same architecture and additionally provides a linguistically interpretable estimate of forecast vagueness. We also show how the linguistic readout of the forecast can be used to detect a permanent switch of a customer to a competitor.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用三角模糊数刻画零售客户偏好，构建 Mamba 型选择性状态空间模型：隐藏状态为三角模糊数，在 Matveev 二元模糊数代数下递推，参数由清晰特征计算，并证明状态始终保持为过去观测的凸组合、模糊度不随时间累积，最终在合成切换场景上做了预测与语言化读出。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「隐状态为模糊量、以非负线性递推保持凸组合从而不累积不确定性」的状态更新机制，可能为 LVR 中承载不确定性的 latent 工作区状态与长链推理下的信息保持提供可核查线索，但该约束能否迁移到多模态视觉状态尚待核查。
